verdicts_or_reports.expected: Rotating the device while editing Pay rent should keep the task editor open in landscape with the task fields available.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The editor closes and the app returns to the QA Filter task list when the device is rotated to landscape. Reproduced twice.
steps: Tap Pay rent to open its editor.
Observe that the task list is shown instead of the editor.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Final dose is configured to occur 1 time, so completing its only occurrence should leave it completed with no further due date in the active list.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After marking Final dose complete, it reopens as an active task with the same December 15 due date; the app reports it was rescheduled for that same date.
steps: Open Final dose in the task editor and verify it says Repeats daily, occurs 1 time.
Observe the snackbar and the still active Final dose row due December 15.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: For a daily repeat anchored to the due date, completion must advance to the next daily occurrence (or finish if the one-occurrence limit is exhausted); it must not reschedule to the same December 15 date.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Completing Final dose reports a reschedule for December 15 again, and its list row remains under Due Tuesday, December 15. The editor still shows Repeats daily, occurs 1 time and Repeats from due date.
steps: Open Final dose and verify its due date is Tuesday, December 15 and its repeat is daily, occurs 1 time, from due date.
Observe that it is rescheduled for the same December 15 date instead of advancing to the next daily occurrence or ending.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: After returning from a task editor to an active search, system Back should collapse search to the task list while keeping Tasks.org in the foreground.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: From the search result with the keyboard hidden, system Back exits Tasks.org to the Android launcher instead of returning to the task list.
steps: Open the active QA Filter list.
Search for guide and open the Read docs result.
Press system Back to return from the editor to the search result; the keyboard is hidden and search remains active.
Observe that the Android launcher opens instead of the task list.
